name: Double spear
body:
Source Martial Arts Handbook pg. 30
Statistics
Cost 25 gp Weight 12 lbs.
Damage 1d6/1d6 (small), 1d8/1d8 (medium); Critical x3; Range —; Type P; Special Double
Category Two-Handed; Proficiency Exotic
Weapon Groups Spears
Description
This long, heavy spear has a point at each end, allowing it to be used as a double weapon.
